questionText: A partnership firm having partners X and Y (Firm #3) with capitals of Rs. 440,000 and Rs. 220,000 suffered a net loss of Rs. 34,000 during the year. The deed provides for interest on capital @ 8% p.a. but does not specify whether it is a charge or appropriation. What is the amount of interest on capital allowable?

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT principles for Company Accounts: Accounting for Share and Debenture Capital (Interest on Capital: Loss Incurred):
No interest on capital will be allowed to any partner

the company would make an application along with the application money

alloted, and letters of regret to those to whom no allotment has been made.

3. Minimum subscription threshold is confirmed: (B).
4. Allotment and regret letters are dispatched: (D).
5. Sequence: (A), (C), (B), (D), matching Option B.
Hence, option (C) is correct.
